items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: In fact, he used to come around to my house, him and Monk and Tad Dameron and Miles and all of the cats and that.

ctx.x: And there was another record company called Deluxe Records, and all of these guys were like hustling up guys to record on -- from 52nd Street, because that's all -- Art Tatum, everybody used to come there. I remember one night Djang Reinhardt had just gotten into town and he couldn't even wait to get to his hotel room. He sent his bags onto the hotel room and he took his guitar and he broke out to 52nd Street and he came over to the "Three Deuces" and he just wanted to sit in and play with some American…

But anyway these guys used to come around and hustle up different groups to make records, and at that time they had hustled Hawk up to make this record. Hawk wanted to be associated -- he was crazy about Thelonious Monk, and to my recollection Monk had the first modern tunes alive. I mean, if
